checks: All 960 direct episodes were recorded and every execution gate passed.
The 32 TEST states matched the frozen ordered hash, were unique, and had no exact full-state overlap with TRAIN or VALIDATION natural panels.
Every p=0 and p=1 exact value matched its direct endpoint-kernel rollout.
All first-overwrite prehistories matched between endpoint kernels, and every p=1 success had zero fixed-path risk.
Independent Decimal recomputation differed by at most 2.6151853571656986135058220021579712E-16.

mathematics.assertion_tested: Compare frozen source, p=1-adapted, and carried_grain>0 gated execution on the predefined PACK TEST natural-start panel, with carry-gated minus source p=0.05 expected return as primary.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Integer path/event counts; IEEE-754 rollout summaries; independent Decimal arithmetic at 50-digit precision for p=0, p=0.05, and p=1 expectations.
mathematics.conventions: Zero-indexed TEST state indices; one-indexed recorded steps; gamma=0.995; deterministic argmax actions; adapted actor exactly when carried_grain>0 in carry-gated mode.
non_claims: TEST changes map geometry as well as initial physical state; this is not an i.i.d. resample of the validation states.
The same five learner seeds and checkpoints are reused, so this does not test generalization to new learned policies.
The gate is evaluator supplied and was not learned.
The prior four seed-35 failures remain a validation-panel case analysis and are not part of this primary comparison.
Exact p=0.05 values are finite-panel expectations derived from deterministic fixed paths.

residual_risks: The policy network and simulator were not independently reimplemented.
The same project codebase generated paths and goal-success labels; endpoint checks and Decimal recomputation reduce but do not remove verifier-designer coupling.
TEST changes geometry and state, so the result is not an i.i.d. resampling estimate.
The same five learned policy pairs were reused, so the result does not test generalization to new learner seeds.
Intermediate-probability values rely on the environment property that any overwrite loss makes the three-delivery goal impossible.
Schema version 1 does not machine-pin every execution input or resource limit.
result: Finite TEST-panel assertion verified: the supplied gate reduced risk and raised mean p=0.05 return over source, but lowered fixed-kernel success and was not seed-consistently better than adapted-only execution; it does not support a normal-performance-preservation claim.
